translation_loss.what_was_lost: The translation of 'aur paate hain' as 'find ourselves further' loses the primary meaning of 'aur' as 'more' (finding ourselves more deeply/fully), which parallels 'aur pehchante hain' (recognize each other more) in line 2. 'Further' introduces an unintended sense of physical or emotional distance.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: Every spoken word carries an unexpressed, deeper, or hidden meaning and subtext.
acceptable_visual_variants: A speaker whose shadow on the wall appears more slumped or reflective than their physical posture
A soft-focus scene where the space between two speakers is filled with deep, quiet shadows
metaphor_spans.literal_meaning: Every spoken word casts a physical silhouette or shadow.
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: Showing literal words floating in the air with physical shadows cast on a wall behind them would look cartoonish and miss the emotional depth.

metaphor_spans.tenor: Fading hope, sadness, or turning away from the external world toward internal feelings
metaphor_spans.vehicle: A fading light source or dimming lamp
metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Depict the characters' eyes looking downcast, soft, or partially in shadow, reflecting a quiet, introspective mood.

translation_loss.what_was_lost: The translation of 'baat' as 'word' loses the broader conversational and situational nuance of the Hindi word, which means 'matter', 'thing said', 'conversation', or 'utterance', rather than just a single lexical word (which is 'shabd').

The translation of 'kam' as 'wanes' changes the grammatical structure from a simple, stark nominal/adjectival ending ('ujala kam' - light is less/diminished) to a dynamic verb, losing the quiet, abrupt rhythm of the original line.

original_poem:
जैसे जैसे अंधेरा बढ़ता है,
हम एक-दूसरे को और पहचानते हैं।
सर्द हवा में जलते हैं दीपक,
हम अपने आप को और पाते हैं।

हर बात में एक छाया होती है,
और हर खामोशी में एक ग़म।
जैसे जैसे अंधेरा बढ़ता है,
हमारी आँखों में उजाला कम।

हम अपनी धड़कनों में खो जाते हैं,
और सब कुछ छिपा होता है शब्दों में।
जैसे जैसे अंधेरा बढ़ता है,
हम एक-दूसरे को महसूस करते हैं।
translated_poem:
As darkness grows,  
We recognize each other more.  
In the cold breeze, lamps burn,  
And we find ourselves further.

Every word has a shadow,  
And every silence holds a sorrow.  
As darkness grows,  
The light in our eyes wanes.

We lose ourselves in our heartbeats,  
And everything hides in words.  
As darkness grows,  
We feel each other more.
